records.author: doug3465
records.title: See how much SOL you’re owed for dead token accounts (r/solana)
records.content: - If you've been active on Solana, it's likely you're owed SOL and don't even know it... Every token you've ever touched (memecoins, airdrops, spam that lands in your wallet) opened a token account that locks up \~0.002 SOL and when the token's gone, that SOL just sits there. So far, a total of 6.7 SOL has been reclaimed through this tool! Check how much you're owed: [owedsol.app](https://owedsol.app) (there's a 1.5% charge) How it works: \- Only closes accounts with zero balance. your tokens and NFTs are never touched \- You approve every tx in your own wallet, the site never sees your keys \- Also shows your wallet card: win rate, fumbles, rugs, and when you trade worst
